title: CIP-185 Governance Action Update
description: Metadata document providing an append-only update to a submitted Cardano governance action, extending CIP-100

hashAlgorithm.title: Hash Algorithm
hashAlgorithm.description: The algorithm used to authenticate this document externally (CIP-100)

authors.title: Authors
authors.description: The authors of this update; witnesses must verify against the original proposal's author keys (CIP-100)

author.title: Author
author.description: An author endorsing the content of a metadata document (CIP-100)

witness.title: Witness
witness.description: A witness proving that the author endorses the content of the metadata

body.title: Body
body.description: The body of the update document that is hashed to produce the witness signatures (CIP-100)

governanceActionId.title: Governance Action ID
governanceActionId.description: The identifier of the on-chain governance action this update pertains to, as <txHash>#<index>

updateType.title: Update Type
updateType.description: The kind of update being made to the referenced governance action

sequenceNumber.title: Sequence Number
sequenceNumber.description: Position of this update in the append-only log for the referenced action, starting at 1

supersedes.title: Supersedes
supersedes.description: The sequenceNumber of a previous update that this update retracts or corrects

updateContext.title: Update Context
updateContext.description: The prose of the update, in Markdown

bindingStatements.title: Binding Statements
bindingStatements.description: Structured statements making the update machine-actionable for downstream reviewers

references.title: References
references.description: Links to off-chain discussions, FAQs, or previous metadata (CIP-100 reference shape)

field.title: Field
field.description: A human-readable locator for the aspect of the proposal being amended

originalText.title: Original Text
originalText.description: The text from the original proposal being clarified or corrected, quoted verbatim

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Why this is an update rather than a new proposal

label.title: Label
label.description: A human readable display name for the reference

uri.title: URI
uri.description: The location of the referenced content

referenceHash.title: Reference Hash
referenceHash.description: Optional integrity hash of the referenced content
